summary: H World Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its first-quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing reports revenue of RMB6.0 billion, net income of RMB817 million, and hotel turnover growth of 17.4% year-over-year. No special-situation event—no merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or similar corporate action—is disclosed. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer. The category is None.
